policy.coreRule: Core contains only the shell, trust/runtime contracts, local state, secure credential client, updater, module host, and thin mesh identity client.
policy.optionalRule: Heavy tools, models, SDKs, emulators, servers, and peer caches are capability packs installed only when selected.

packages.name: Neyvia desktop shell
Agent runtime and orchestration
Capability OS and permission broker
Context, artifact, and lineage engine
Local metadata, search, and durable session state
OS secure-store and opaque secret-handle client
packages.gap: OS keyring storage exists; the cross-device opaque-handle broker is not implemented.

packages.name: Sandboxed module host and installer
packages.gap: Signed content packs and zero-grant WebAssembly modules can be verified, scanned, activated, disabled, and rolled back. Full applications and long-running services remain blocked until the OS/container sandbox, health-window rollback, and registry revocation feed are implemented.

packages.name: Signed Neyvia update client
packages.gap: Signed update artifacts and the in-app install action exist; GitHub signing secrets and the first published latest.json feed are still required.

packages.name: Thin private-mesh identity and route client
packages.gap: The provider-neutral control layer and non-disruptive Tailscale bridge are verified. The selected NetBird client, NAS control plane, Android enrollment, relay proof, and recovery cutover are not deployed.

packages.name: Documents, PDF, office, language, and translation
packages.gap: PDF, LibreOffice, Pandoc, and LaTeX are integrated; grammar and translation engines remain planned.

packages.name: Modern local OCR and document understanding
Marketplace SDK, templates, signing, and publishing tools
packages.gap: Build, detached signing, validation, and local/NAS seed publishing are implemented. Project templates, compatibility emulators, public OCI publishing, and a publisher-facing guided workflow remain incomplete.

packages.name: Android SDK, emulator, Appium, and device lab
iOS app studio and authorized build workers
packages.gap: Project creation and build paths exist; marketplace app packaging and a complete simulator matrix do not.

packages.name: Developer toolchains and application services
Local model and GPU runtime
packages.gap: Pinned OCR runtimes are verified; a general model lifecycle and evaluation pack is not complete.

packages.name: Media, 3D, CAD, game, and publishing studio
NAS worker, verified transfer, and artifact mirror
Self-hosted private-mesh control plane and relay
Nearby encrypted send
packages.gap: The LocalSend v2.1 sender and optional 1.17.0 compatibility client are verified. The Neyvia receiver sidecar, text/link first-class payloads, favorite-device policy, and Windows-to-Android physical-device proof remain.

packages.name: Peer folder synchronization
packages.gap: The Syncthing 2.1.2 transport is staged and the authenticated, credential-hiding Neyvia control contract is implemented. Creating the isolated production identity, pairing the NAS and Android peers, proving reconnect/conflict/version-restore on physical devices, and installing the supervised demand-start service remain.

packages.name: Cross-device encrypted chat, links, and file handoff
packages.gap: The Matrix 1.157.1 compatibility stack, Element clients, and the credential-hiding Neyvia chat contract are implemented. A private NAS homeserver, protected production account and crypto store, cross-device verification, real encrypted-room send/read proof, and the native stdin/IPC sidecar remain before production activation.

packages.name: Private password vault and secret broker
packages.gap: Vaultwarden 1.36.0 and the verified Bitwarden CLI OSS 2026.7.0 transport are selected, and the opaque destination-bound Neyvia broker is implemented. NAS Vaultwarden deployment, protected account/session provisioning, real client interoperability, fixed production destination bindings, OS credential-store integration, and physical autofill/share proof remain.

packages.name: Private peer-to-peer immutable object cache
packages.gap: The BLAKE3 local CAS, SQLite index, hash-bound imports, deduplication, bounded offline reads, authenticated Iroh 1.0.3/iroh-blobs 0.103.0 fetch sidecar, lazy persistent client session, and supervised approval-gated provider lifecycle are implemented. Production peer enrollment, a private relay, multi-peer scheduling, replication policy, quota/GC policy, Android binding, signed release distribution, and measured Windows-Android-NAS context latency remain.
